changelog.text: Adopted TN 40 / OA 40 / IPO 20. IPO is on paper, so its share is held in the liquid ETF until the sleeve graduates.

No gold sleeve for now (Arun). Targets stay TN 40 / OA 40 / IPO 20. research/147 and research/154 both favoured a gold allocation on the numbers; this is a deliberate choice not to add a fourth sleeve while the third is untraded, not a refutation of the finding.
IPO sleeve armed for real money by a Rs 228,711 deposit through the Capital Desk. Execution stays manual-assisted until an executor exists.
